SELECT r.id, r.apply_no AS applyNo, r.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, r.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, r.product_id AS productId, r.product_name AS productName, r.fault_desc AS faultDesc,
r.images AS imagesRaw, r.contact_name AS contactName, r.contact_phone AS contactPhone, r.address AS address, r.status AS status, r.warranty_type AS warrantyType, r.handle_remark AS handleRemark, r.handler_id AS handlerId, r.handle_time AS handleTime, r.create_time AS createTime FROM repair_apply r LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = r.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND o.deleted = 0
r.deleted = 0
AND r.apply_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.applyNo}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.nickname}, '%')
AND r.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.productName}, '%')
AND r.status = #{q.status}
AND r.warranty_type = #{q.warrantyType}
AND r.create_time >= #{q.startDate}
AND r.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{q.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY r.status ASC, r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
